collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-19  -  THE PROMISE FORGOTTEN SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A teenager remembers too late that they promised to help an elder carry weaving materials earlier that morning.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A teenager remembers too late that they promised to help an elder carry weaving materials earlier that morning.

choices.label: Explain honestly why the promise was forgotten.
Offer to help with tomorrow's work instead.
Ask how to make amends without assuming forgiveness.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The elder accepts the apology and asks for assistance with the remaining bundles.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The work is already finished, and the teenager must accept that the missed help mattered.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The elder listens but asks the teenager to plan more carefully next time.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The explanation feels uncomfortable, yet the teenager is relieved to have told the truth.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The elder agrees, and the teenager makes a careful effort to remember.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder declines because tomorrow's tasks require someone else.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The elder suggests repairing a worn carrying strap.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The elder needs time before discussing it, and the teenager respects that.
